answer: Charge every grading identity a bond sized to the worst harm one false grade can cause, and pay slashes straight to the victims — a farm keeps no rebate. Clone-to-clone insurance must move coins, and the fund-flow graph exposes it: recurring settlement loops between 'independent' identities mark one operator, and every member forfeits. At dawn a fleet of N shills posts N collateral bonds it can never amortize, while a lone honest quill, inked in the nectar of earned attestations, holds one seat for one stake.
